items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Little Daddy played piano with me for a while there.

ctx.x: What was Little Daddy's brother's name? Which Little Daddy is this?
Little Daddy piano player, a little short fella. Last time I saw him, he was pretty sick. He could hardly walk. If I heard his name, I would know him.
Was he, did he, did you know Kid Ernest?
